attributes.name: login form container
attributes.definition: How the login/sign-in interface is structured in the markup.

values.definition: Login is a native dialog element containing a form.
Login form appears inline or on its own page without a dialog element.
Other login treatment or no login present.

attributes.name: html lang region
attributes.definition: Whether the html lang attribute includes a regional subtag.

values.definition: lang names only the language, e.g. 'en'.
lang includes a region subtag, e.g. 'en-US'.

attributes.name: post wrapper markup
attributes.definition: Which elements wrap individual posts/content items and their media.

values.definition: Each post is an article element with no figure/figcaption wrappers.
Posts are articles and media uses figure/figcaption.
No post items on the page.

attributes.name: heading rendering
attributes.definition: Whether headings are rendered as live text or as images.

values.definition: Headings are real text styled with CSS/fonts.
Some headings are text and some are images.
